Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the chase to begin! The players of Bangladesh are out in the middle. Assad Vala and Lega Siaka are the opening batters for Papua New Guinea! Mohammad Saifuddin will start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

So, the target is a huge one! Bangladesh will surely back themselves to win this. In fact they will be looking to keep PNG down to a low total and get a big win. PNG on the other hand, need a miracle. One assumes they will go out there and have some fun but they someone to play an absolute blinder.

Kabua Morea is up for a chat. He says that one boundary was long so they were trying to make the Bangladeshi batters hit across the line. Tells that their fielding was pretty good and they are looking forward to chase it down.

A total of 7 bowlers is what PNG used and they bowled well in bits and pieces. Kabua Morea and Damien Ravu did a decent job up front. Assad Vala was also impressive in the middle overs, however, it was the death overs where the game completely slipped away from them. Their bowlers took a real pounding towards the end and conceded more than 60 runs in the last 5. Despite that though there were a few positives for them like their fielding which was on point in this game. They took a few stunners and were really throwing themselves around. Had it not been for their fielding, Bangladesh may have crossed the 190-run mark.

The start for Bangladesh was not the best one though as they lost Mohammad Naim early. Liton Das and Shakib Al Hasan then steadied the ship with a 50-run stand. Bangladesh then lost two quickly as Mushfiqur Rahim did not last long in the middle after Das fell. Shakib Al Hasan along with Mahmudullah laid the platform but just as it was time to accelerate, Shakib Al Hasan fell. Mahmudllah though continued and smashed a brilliant half ton. He did fall towards the end but Mohammad Saifuddin played a brilliant cameo and added the finishing touches.

A very strong finish from Bangladesh has seen them breach the 180-run mark and we believe that is well over par. Mahmudullah will be very pleased with the work done by his batters after he elected to bat.
FOUR! 17 runs off the last 3 balls! Full ball, on off. Mohammad Saifuddin stays back and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a boundary. Bangladesh finish with 181/7.
NO BALL AND A SIX! Spoils the over! Another ball, in the slot, around middle. Mohammad Saifuddin smacks it over the mid-wicket region for another maximum! Free Hit to follow!
SIX! BANG! A much-needed biggie for Bangladesh! Length ball, on middle and leg. Mohammad Saifuddin stands tall and tonks it way, way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum!
Short ball, around off. Mahedi Hasan pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Mahedi Hasan looks to heave it away but he does not get any blade on it.
Full ball, outside off. Mohammad Saifuddin slices it to deep point for one.
Banged in short, around middle. Mahedi Hasan looks to pull but it goes off the top edge towards fine leg. The batters cross for a run.
Mahedi Hasan walks out to bat now. Chad Soper (3-0-33-0) is back on.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one departs! Slower ball, way outside off. Afif Hossain moves across and looks to slog it over deep mid-wicket but it goes off the toe end towards Damien Ravu at deep mid-wicket who takes a good catch running forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Damien Ravu b Kabua Morea

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Full ball, on the pads. Afif Hossain whips it off his pads to the vacant fine leg region for a boundary.
Slower ball, on a length, darted on the pads. Mohammad Saifuddin tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain drags it to wide of long on. The fielder there moves to his left and keeps it to just one.
Another single! Good-length ball, on off. Mohammad Saifuddin blocks it to covers to rotate the strike.
Slower ball, on a length, around off. Afif Hossain skips down and drills it to long on for one.
Mohammad Saifuddin walks out to bat.
OUT! TAKEN! Another wicket for Ravu! Short ball, on off. Nurul Hasan taps it straight to short third man. Sese Bau takes it with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c Sese Bau b Damien Ravu

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full ball, on off. Afif Hossain paddles it over the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! Edgy! Full ball, way outside off. Afif Hossain gets the outside edge to the third man fence.
Nurul Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Absolute drama out in the middle! Papua New Guinea get a crucial breakthrough here! A full toss, around waist high. Mahmudullah flicks it but straight to the fielder at deep square leg. Chad Soper there makes no mistake. The on-field umpire checks whether it was above the waist but the third umpire suggests that it is a legal delivery! The signal on the big screen is NOT OUT, the on-field umpire has a word with the third umpire and the decision is then changed to OUT. Mahmudullah walks back in disbelief.
Commentary.Howout: c Chad Soper b Damien Ravu

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Is that a no ball? The catch is taken but the umpires are going upstairs if it was above the waist. It looks to be above the waist. The big screen shows NOT OUT. Hold on, there is some confusion. It is now changed and the big screen shows OUT now.
Wide! Full and wide outside off. Afif Hossain lets it through to the keeper. Wided!
Damien Ravu to continue.

FOUR! What a way to end the over! Mahmudullah also brings up his fifty! He has certainly led from the front in this must-win encounter! Short and wide ball. Mahmudullah stays back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
SIX! High and handsome! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Mahmudullah frees his arms and sends it sailing over long on for a massive biggie!
Swing and a miss! Short ball, outside off. Mahmudullah throws the sink at it but he fails to get any bat on it.
No ball! Slower ball, banged into the deck, outside off. Mahmudullah leaves it alone. Free Hit coming up!

Slower ball, shorter in length, around leg. Afif Hossain tucks it behind square on the leg side for a run. The keeper moves across to his right and has a shy at the striker's end. There is a direct hit but Mahmudullah is well inside.
Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah reaches out and digs it out to deep cover for one.
SIX! BANG! A low full toss, around off. Mahmudullah heaves it way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum!
Length ball, on off. Flicked past mid-wicket for one.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mahmudullah pulls it past square leg for one.
On a length, outside off. Afif Hossain runs it past point for one.
Full ball, outside off. Afif Hossain misses the drive.
Length ball, down the leg side. Afif misses the flick. Wide called.
Short ball, on off. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Really well played! Length ball, way outside off. Mahmudullah runs it between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Pushed past covers for one.
FOUR! Clever shot! Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Pushed past covers for one.
Just short of the fielder! Full ball, on off. Afif Hossain chips it in the air to deep square leg. The man from fine leg runs towards it and dives but cannot get there. Two taken.
On a length, around off. Blocked out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Pushed past point for one.
Kabua Morea (2-0-9-1) is back on.
Loopy ball, on off. Flicked away for one.
Tossed up, on off. Clipped to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! WHAT A CATCH! Oh my word! That is a stunner! Vala fires it outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to go downtown but gets it from the inner half of the bat. The ball goes to the right of long on. Charles Amini runs towards the ball and then dives to catch the ball just inches above the ground. That is some catch to send back Shakib Al Hasan!
Commentary.Howout: c Charles Amini b Assad Vala

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive but misses.
SIX! A one-handed maximum for Shakib Al Hasan! Full ball, outside off. He hits it way over the long on fence for a biggie.
Flatter ball, on the pads. Mahmudullah works it past square leg for one.
Assad Vala comes back to bowl.
A single to end the over. Full ball, on off. Pushed to cover.
Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to reverse sweep but misses.
Just a single as this is hit to long off.
Full ball, on off. Mahmudullah pushes it past covers for one.
Shorter ball, on off. Pushed down the ground for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Chopped past point for one.
Another single but 12 from the over! On middle, this is worked through square leg.
Fires it on the pads, Hasan works it through square leg for one.
Mahmudullah shuffles across, this is a yorker outside off, he jams it to short third man for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Probably felt Shakib would come down the track and fires it way outside off. Shakib does not and leaves it alone. Wided.
Comes down the track again, this time hits it all along the ground through mid on. The fielder in the deep, runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to one.
SIX! Mahmudullah wastes not time! Just his 4th ball, skips down the track and hits it high and over the long on fence for a biggie.
Another single to end a successful over for Papua New Guinea. On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Shorter and on middle, works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the pads, this is played fine on the leg side for two.
Mahmudullah walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Mushfiqur Rahim will be gutted! That was a poor ball and he could have hit it anywhere but picks out the fielder! This is very short, it sits up to be hit. Rahim rocks back and hammers the ball, he hits it flat but straight to the man at deep square leg. Hiri Hiri takes a sharp catch as the ball pops out of his hands once. The break does the job. Bangladesh in a spot of bother.
Commentary.Howout: c Hiri Hiri b Simon Atai

Commentary.Commentary: On off, this is swept through square leg for one.

Drinks break! Bangladesh have started steadily but they need to finish well here and they would hope that these two at the crease, the most experienced men in their squad take them to a good total! Shakib Al Hasan is struggling out in the middle due to the heat and he would be looking to up the ante now as he does not look in a position to rotate the strike now.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Two! Edgy! Outside off, shorter. Shakib slashes, it goes off the outside edge fine on the off side. Two.

NOT OUT! Shakib is well in! Really good fielding though! This is tossed up on off, Shakib looks to go over covers but due to the away turn, it squirts off the outer half a lot squarer than Shakib would have liked. They take one and go for the second. The throw is a good one to the keeper, right over the bails. The keeper takes it and whips it off. Appeals but replays show that Shakib's stretch saves him.
Is that a run out? Nope, Shakib Al Hasan is inside the crease.
Slightly shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for one.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
SIX! That is nailed! What a hit! On middle, Shakib Al Hasan goes down on one knee and hits it well over the square leg fence for a welcome biggie. Really nailed that.
Another single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Well fielded! Shorter and on middle, Rahim pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left, dives and keeps it down to one.
On off, this is driven but to covers.
Sees Shakib come down the track, shortens the length. Shakib pushes it past the bowler and down to long on for one.
Another one tossed up and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it late towards short third man and takes a quick run.
Tossed up, around off. Shakib Al Hasan drills it to long off for one.
A half-tracker, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim rocks back and cuts it past point to get off the mark with a single.
Just a tad short, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it towards backward point.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan tucks it behind square on the leg side for one.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a move by Assad Vala to bring himself on! He strikes on his very first ball and Liton Das has to walk back. Tossed up, outside off. Liton Das looks to sweep but it goes off the splice of the bat towards Sese Bau at deep square leg who takes a good catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Sese Bau b Assad Vala

Commentary.Commentary: Assad Vala comes on now.
A single to end the over! Short of a length, outside off. Liton Das hangs back and pulls it along the ground towards deep mid-wicket.
Banged in short, around off. Shakib Al Hasan taps it to backward point and takes a single.
Swing and a miss! Slower ball, shorter in length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan shimmies down to slog it but he misses.
Back of a length, on off. Shakib Al Hasan whips it wide of deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, on off, cramping Shakib Al Hasan for room. He pushes it back to the bowler.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Liton Das flicks it to deep square to collect a run.
Chad Soper (1-0-9-0) is back on.
Flatter ball, on middle. Liton Das tucks it to the right of the bowler for a run. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 45/1.
Excellent running again! Floated, around off. Liton Das tucks it wide of deep mid-wicket and collects another couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on middle. Liton Das turns it to the leg side for a couple of runs.
Review time. Papua New Guinea have reviewed this for LBW. No bat on that one. But the impact is way outside off.

NOT OUT! Liton Das survives and Papua New Guinea lose their review! Tossed up, outside off, turning in late. Das looks to sweep but he misses and gets hit on his pads. Sese Bau appeals but the umpire says no. Papua New Guinea opt for a review but the Ball Tracker shows that the impact was outside off so the on-field decision stays.
Tossed up, around off. Liton Das pushes it to wide of long on and calls for two. The fielder there fumbles and the batters complete the second run quite easily.
Flatter ball, on leg. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Change. Chad Soper was all set to bowl but Assad Vala has gone with Sese Bau to bowl now.
Good-length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan taps it to covers and takes off for a run. 6 runs off the over!

Length ball, around off. Liton Das pushes it to mid off, off the front foot and scampers through for one. The fielder at mid off hits the stumps at the bowler's end but Das was well inside the crease!
Wide! Full ball, way outside off. Liton Das lets it be. Wide called by the umpire.
Lovely delivery! Another slower ball, on a length, outside off. Liton Das skips down to loft it but he misses and the ball goes just past the off pole.
Good-length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it past covers and takes a run.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Liton Das lofts it over cover and takes a single.
A low full toss, around off. Shakib Al Hasan heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there moves to his left to stop the ball. A single taken!
Short of a length, outside off. Tapped to third man for one.
Length ball, way down the leg side. Shakib Al Hasan misses the flick. Wide called.
Fuller ball, on off. Driven to short cover but a midfield allows the single.
FOUR! Nicely punched! On a length, outside off. Das punches it through point for a boundary.
Short ball, on off. Das sits under it.
On a length, on off. Pushed to mid off for one.
SIX! Up and away! Right in the slot for Shakib Al Hasan. The southpaw frees his arms and sends the ball sailing over the long on fence.
Back of a length, outside off. Liton Das runs it down to third man for a single.
Length ball, on the pads. Das flicks it to fine leg for a single.
SIX! That is a quality stroke and it will give Das some much-needed confidence! On a length, outside off. Das shuffles across and sweeps it over the fine leg fence.
On a length, on off. Hit back to the bowler.
Length ball, around off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive but gets the inner half to mid on for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Pushed to point. Dot ball.
On a length, on off. Das drives it to mid off and takes off for a single.
Chad Soper comes to bowl.
Short ball, on leg. Shakib lets the ball sail over him.
Full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it hard down the ground but Ravu gets down and stops it.
Short of a length, on off. Das runs it to third man for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan slashes it over covers for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Das works it past mid on for one.
Length ball, on off. Pushed to covers. Das wants one but is sent back by Shakib Al Hasan.
Who will bowl from the other end? Damien Ravu it is.
Dot to finish the over! Full ball, on off. Hit to mid on by Shakib Al Hasan. Just 3 runs and a wicket from the over.
Full ball, on the pads. Das flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan goes for the drive but gets the inside edge past the pads for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Pushed past short third man for one. Bangladesh and Das are underway!
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! It carries this time and it is taken! On a length, on the pads. Naim heaves it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder takes a couple of steps back and tumbles backward to take the catch. A good take in the end by Sese Bau.
Commentary.Howout: c Sese Bau b Kabua Morea

Commentary.Commentary: Almost carried to the keeper! Length ball, around off. Naim gets the outside edge while looking to block. The keeper dives to his left but the ball falls just short of him.

The players are out for their respective national anthems! First, the anthem of Papua New Guinea will be played, followed by the anthem of Bangladesh! We are done with the national anthems and the players of Papua New Guinea are in a huddle before striding out to the middle. Liton Das and Mohammad Naim are the opening batters for Bangladesh. Kabua Morea will start with the ball.

PITCH REPORT - Preston Mommsen is down for the pitch report. Murali Karthik joins him and he says that the pitch is a fresh one. Adds that Mahedi Hasan has been sensational for Bangladesh thanks to his trajectory and the lengths he bowls. Says that the wicket is a good one to bat on.

Assad Vala, the skipper of Papua New Guinea, says that the team is very excited to play against Bangladesh. Adds that they have nothing to lose and will play fearless cricket. Mentions that there are two changes in the side. Says that the wicket looks quite good and they are looking forward to it.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, says the wicket looks a good one to bat on so they will try to put a good total on the board and try to defend it. States they have had a good chat, they have not played to their potential and he hopes they can do well here. Ends by informing no changes made by them.

Papua New Guinea (Playing XI) - Hiri Hiri (In for Tony Ura), Lega Siaka, Assad Vala (C), Charles Amini, Sese Bau, Simon Atai, Norman Vanua, Kiplin Doriga (WK), Chad Soper, Kabua Morea, Damien Ravu (In for Nosaina Pokana).

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Liton Das, Mohammad Naim, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Bangladesh. They will bat first.

Papua New Guinea are almost out of contention for making it to the Super 12 stage and it will be nothing less than a miracle if they manage to progress further. They lost their first two games and are languishing at the bottom of the points table. PNG would look to end the qualifying stage on a high but they will face a side that is hungry for a win in Bangladesh and nothing is going to come easy for them. Will we witness an upset in this mega event? Only time will tell. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

Bangladesh did manage to win their last game against Oman after a hiccup against Scotland in their opening game. They need to win this game in order to progress to the next stage but they would also have their eyes on the next league game where Scotland will face Oman. The Bangla Tigers would hope that Scotland hand a defeat to Oman which will see them go through to the Super 12 stage and the net run rate scenario will be out of the equation. But first things first, they have to win this game to stay in contention and if they lose, then they would hope that Oman suffers a heavy defeat, which will bring their net run rate down, and eventually, it will be Bangladesh and Scotland who will qualify for the next stage. Mahmudullah and his men would be eager to put their best foot forward to push for a win, if not a comprehensive one. Will Bangladesh qualify for the Super 12 stage? Well, we will find that soon.

Hello and welcome to this penultimate game of the qualifying stage of ICC Men's T20 World Cup, Group B where Bangladesh will face Papua New Guinea. This promises to be an exciting encounter as the teams have all to play for as we approach the Super 12 stage.
....Match Day....
